period.reason: Fixed 14 UTC days before existing prospective M1 observation; no sealed study journal or interim outcomes accessed

input.past_covariate: fraction of original 18 assets with negative trailing 1h return; first 12 context values missing

rules.timestral: SHORT if median predicted return from current BTC mark to step73 is at most -1 percent
rules.m1: SHORT if actual unchanged M1 momentum_breadth detector is true
rules.simple: SHORT if observed BTC trailing1h return is at most -1 percent, without breadth
rules.forecast_reference: persistence forecast: future log BTC equals current log BTC

execution.book: first accepted raw L5 observed at or after execution due time
execution.funding: Actual BTC settlement rates and preceding marks from Original journal, used only as outcomes; complete 8h settlement coverage required
execution.missing: Keep censored episode and do not invent fill/PnL; unresolved trade halts that method subsequent entries
execution.account_semantics: Fixed-notional non-overlapping BTC sleeve event study, not a replay of actual V13 multiasset account or live M1 basket

metrics: forecast MAE/RMSE in log-return bps vs persistence
80 percent quantile coverage and interval width
per-UTC-day paired forecast errors; no iid significance claim
all raw signals, admissions, censored and completed episodes
sum of hypothetical fixed-size episode net PnL, fees, funding and stress
limitations: Historical reuse; not an untouched holdout
Model post-training data and cutoff unknown: no claim of out-of-training historical prices
Only Timestral-5M zero-shot, no fine tuning or model/threshold selection
M1 formula compared on identical BTC sleeve, not live account returns
